_doc: Live symbol namespace for the arifOS federation. A symbol here is BINDING — it carries enforcement, history and floors. Never redefine one; never mint a new axis over it. Written by hand for ratified canon (floors, ratified fragments); machine-derived counts live in the registry, not here. Probe BEFORE importing any external notation: /root/scripts/symbol-probe.py
